subject.title: Review each selected PR in its own item shard

question: Should maintainers authorize the isolated protocol-v3 canary and two-item live validation before merging this scheduler and durable-queue redesign?
rationale: The changed behavior coordinates GitHub Actions cancellation with Durable Object generation and mutation ownership; source tests cannot establish the production handoff and recovery properties without a controlled live run.

options.title: Validate the canary first
options.body: Run the isolated two-item canary, capture the stated cancellation, publication, reconciliation, and telemetry evidence, then refresh review before merge.

options.title: Accept a managed rollout risk
options.body: Merge without the canary only if maintainers explicitly accept that the new cross-workflow cancellation and mutation contract has not been demonstrated in a live isolated environment.

options.title: Pause the scheduler redesign
options.body: Keep the current shard model until a narrower rollout plan or dedicated staging environment makes the protocol-v3 behavior independently observable.

recommendation.title: Validate the canary first
recommendation.body: Run the isolated two-item canary, capture the stated cancellation, publication, reconciliation, and telemetry evidence, then refresh review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor for the coupled queue, workflow, and status-projection design and can provide the proposed canary evidence.
